name: pixabay-media
description: Search, download, and license royalty-free stock photos, illustrations, vectors, and stock footage from Pixabay. Use whenever someone needs a stock image, stock video, B-roll, background photo, or stock media for a site, deck, video, or social post.

pixabay_api_key.title: Pixabay API key
pixabay_api_key.description: Your Pixabay API key (https://pixabay.com/api/docs/ -> 'Get API Key'). Stored in secure credential storage, never in settings.json. Needed for every image and video search.
